issue: The relational claim "lies outside this range" is arithmetically false under every reading: the self-host monthly total $155,816.93 is contained within the quoted cloud-rental range $87.6K–$306.6K, and its per-1K figure $24.97 is contained within $14.04–$49.13. fix_instruction: Replace "lies outside this range" with wording that names the category, not the interval, e.g. "is a separate capex+energy cost basis, not a point in this cloud-rental series" or "does not belong to the cloud-rental comparison above".
